## Importing dataset
```{r}
# Looking at the sheets in the file

excel_sheets("202610 Trash Wheel Collection Data.xlsx")

#importing and cleaning the the mr trash wheel dataset

mr_trash_df = read_excel("202610 Trash Wheel Collection Data.xlsx",
                      sheet = "Mr. Trash Wheel",
                      range = "A2:N742",
                      na = c("","NA", ".")
                      ) |>
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  drop_na(dumpster) |> 
  mutate(sports_balls = as.integer(round(sports_balls)))
```
